data: Does Hadoop take more time than Console when processing 16 GB of data?

The graph shows two lines representing Hadoop and Console's performance in terms of time taken for processing different sizes of data. The x-axis represents the total size of data in GB, ranging from 0.1 to 16 GB. The y-axis represents the time taken in minutes, ranging from 0 to 400 minutes.

At 16 GB of data, the red line (Console) is above the blue line (Hadoop), indicating that Console takes more time than Hadoop. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes, Hadoop takes less time than Console when processing 16 GB of data.
